faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about cooking with CookMitra AI

items.question: What is CookMitra AI?
items.answer: CookMitra AI is an AI-powered cooking companion built for Indian home cooking. It helps you generate recipes from ingredients you already have, plan healthy weekly meals, chat with an AI cooking assistant, and manage your kitchen pantry — all in one place.

items.question: Is CookMitra AI free to use?
items.answer: Yes! CookMitra AI is completely free during our hackathon demo period. Check out our Pricing page for a look at how the product could evolve in the future.

items.question: How does the AI Recipe Generator work?
items.answer: Just type in the ingredients you have (or scan a photo of your pantry, or use voice input), set your budget and cook time preferences, and our AI crafts a complete recipe with instructions, nutrition info, and a cost breakdown — tailored to what's actually in your kitchen.

items.question: What is Batch Cooking mode?
items.answer: Toggle on Batch Cooking mode when generating a recipe, choose how many days you're cooking for, and the AI will scale the recipe up accordingly plus add storage and reheating instructions — perfect for students and hostel life.

items.question: Who is Chef Momo?
items.answer: Chef Momo is your AI cooking assistant, available anytime to answer cooking questions, suggest substitutions, and help troubleshoot recipes in real time — just like texting a knowledgeable friend.

items.question: Can I save my favorite recipes?
items.answer: Yes — tap 'Save Recipe' on any generated or library recipe, and it'll appear in 'My Saved Recipes' for quick access anytime.

items.question: What is the Pantry feature?
items.answer: My Pantry lets you keep a running list of ingredients you have at home, so you don't have to retype them every time you want a recipe. You can manually pull items from your Pantry into the Recipe Generator whenever you'd like.

items.question: How accurate are the cost and nutrition estimates?
items.answer: Estimates are AI-generated based on typical Indian grocery prices and standard nutritional data. They're meant as helpful guidance, not exact figures — actual costs and nutrition may vary by brand, region, and season.

items.question: Can I share recipes with friends?
items.answer: Yes — use the 'Share to WhatsApp' button on any generated recipe to send a nicely formatted version straight to a chat.

items.question: How do I contact support?
items.answer: If you have any questions or need assistance, you can reach out to our support team by emailing cookmitra.ai@gmail.com. We're always happy to help!

items.question: Is my data private?
items.answer: Your saved recipes, pantry, and preferences are stored securely and tied to your account — only you can access them.
